testsuite.name: org.panchang.api.PublicationControlsApiTest

testcase.name: approved API and structured files agree while legacy refuses unsupported contract()
API structured files and legacy agree that unapproved guidance cannot publish()
unconfigured public day and year explicitly withhold calculated guidance()
Reykjavik sunrise dispute remains separate from corrected daylight delivery()
known dispute is visible even when computed observance is absent on the reference date()
test-only approved January carryover retains previous fasting date and Parana()
public output refuses reuse of a directory containing old artifacts()
approved empty day and withheld day cannot be confused()
regional missing observance rules are unsupported even with a test-only owner record()
query header and anonymous body cannot forge approval or enable a review API()
revocation blocks next API response and already prepared file publication()
